style: Premium Korean cinematic animation film still, realistic expressive webtoon/manhwa hybrid 2D hand-painted digital illustration, consistent hand-drawn outlines, warm film-like lighting, detailed natural interiors and expressions, NOT a photograph, NOT a presentation slide, NOT a poster, no writing or lettering, all scenes 16:9

shots.description: Opening confrontation, present day: Somin 49 in foreground with quietly wet eyes, her 70-year-old mother on sofa saying something dismissive, modest Korean apartment living room at night, medium two-shot
Close-up Somin alone at her apartment dining table looking at a bank transfer phone screen, dim table lamp and unopened bills, shock and suppressed hurt
Flashback childhood: affluent Korean family in comfortable 1980s home, elegant younger mother adjusting the schoolgirl Somin's collar, father in suit, happy but formal
Flashback early adulthood: father's small business closes, adult young Somin faces stacks of bills in a modest office as father sits defeated, melancholic rainy window
Young Somin 23 drawing illustrations late at night at a cluttered desk, worn hand, modest bedroom, warm lamp, no text on papers
Young Somin opens bedroom door: mother and two friends chatting late-night around tea and cards; Somin asks them to be quiet, conflict in eyes
Somin as a bride standing beside caring husband in a modest Korean wedding hall, guests blurred, bittersweet foreshadowing
Newly married couple carry groceries and repair items into her parents' apartment, mother relieved, husband kind but tired
Close-up Somin's hand writing family household ledger with rent and monthly transfers, small kitchen table, receipts, tired expression
Somin teaching children watercolor at a lively small art academy, colorful drawings, she smiles while exhausted
Divorced Somin walking away from family court alone carrying document envelope on gloomy rainy afternoon, dignity and grief
Her mother tests a new sofa in apartment as Somin reluctantly pays by card, Somin's school-age son watches with concern
Somin alone in art studio receiving angry call from younger brother on mobile, face pale, painting brushes in background
Closeup hands sorting fourteen years of printed Korean bank-transfer records across floor, Somin overwhelmed, wet eyes, NO legible bank text
Somin and younger brother 40 seated at kitchen table looking at old transfer sheets, the brother stunned and apologetic
Family confrontation at parent's dining table, Somin with paperwork, mother defensive, younger brother shocked, father seated silently
Close shot mother around 70 avoiding Somin's gaze and admitting she kept the payments secret from brother
Somin seated across mother at table, crying but sitting upright with determined face, brother listens in silence
Somin inside parked car at night after family fight, hands trembling on steering wheel, streetlights reflect tears
Somin sits on carpet at home, crying while embracing her school-age son, warm modest apartment, strong emotional connection
Close-up Somin smartphone screen with unread mother texts, Somin hesitates with one hand, soft cloudy morning light, no legible screen text
Somin and younger brother talk together quietly at a small cafe deciding to share parents' responsibilities, tentative relief
Mother alone in overly large apartment living room that she refuses to downsize, suitcases and formal furniture, lonely elegance
Somin looks at old family photo in bedroom at sunset, her own reflection on glass, memories and conflicted love
Mother elegantly dressed attending friends' coffee gathering while financial anxiety remains, upscale cafe, isolated undertone
Somin shows household budget notebook to her defensive mother across apartment dining table, mother folds her arms, tense but not violent
Childhood flashback teenage Somin showing a watercolor painting and school report to mother who compares her to others, delicate hurt
Somin age 49 working late alone at small art academy, after all the students leave, lights half off, fatigue
Ailing elderly father with dementia in armchair looking confused at family photos, Somin watching with sadness
Somin at watercolor class teaching children when she gets emergency phone call, blue paint on hand and frightened face
Hospital emergency corridor at night, older mother disheveled and frightened, Somin arrives hurriedly carrying handbag
Doctor calmly explains father's fall and injury to Somin younger brother and mother in hospital consultation room
Somin, brother and older mother plan medical care together around hospital table, all three share responsibility, serious teamwork
Close-up mother's hands with expense notebook and calculator, realizing living costs, Somin's gentle supportive hand nearby
Hospital bed: elderly father holds Somin's hand and seems to remember her childhood painting, tender natural light, no medical gore
Somin alone at hospital window at dawn writing a promise in smartphone memo, dreaming of drawing again, quiet hopeful
Older mother visits small but cozy apartment with realtor, tentative acceptance of downsizing, Somin beside her supportive but allowing choice
Mother and Somin sort moving boxes at old apartment, sentimental family objects, soft nostalgic afternoon
Somin opens old box of colorful childhood drawings at mother's house, astonishment, sunlight on worn watercolor papers
Mother and Somin sit on floor surrounded by old paintings discussing their conflicting memories, intimate gentle reconciliation
Somin age 49 at home computer filling art-therapy training application, nervous and hopeful, no readable screen text
Somin and her school-age son laugh while sketching together at table with fresh paint palettes, a new beginning
Somin visits parents in smaller modest apartment and mother respects her boundary, both relaxed, father resting behind
Somin and older mother have lunch facing each other at humble Korean restaurant, small plate of favorite food
Close-up tearful mother admits she pretended not to know daughter's hardship, Somin listens with hurt but compassion
Somin and mother gently hold hands across restaurant table, healing but not magically perfect, subtle warm light
Somin attending art-therapy painting class as adult learner, her focused face and classmates, colorful studio, daylight
Final cinematic image: Somin at wooden easel paints portrait of two women walking different paths beside each other, mature hopeful smile, morning sunlight
